entries.zh: 尚且；姑且将就着做，约略为之（不求精确）
entries.en: to do (something) more or less, roughly; to make do approximately
entries.notes: 「尚且」字面为犹且、尚可，西语 a poco más o menos 指约略而行，取将就之义。

entries.zh: 尚简；崇尚简约、从简而行（不求精细）
entries.en: to prefer the simple; to do in a simplified way, without precision
entries.notes: 「尚简」本义崇尚简约，与西语约略为之相承，属引申用法。

entries.zh: 遽然；突然、贸然动手去做，并无过错
entries.en: to set about doing something abruptly; suddenly, rashly (without wrong-doing)
entries.notes: H 首字有[疑]（遽/濃），M cû 对应 kù，可定为「遽然」。

entries.zh: 径自；擅自照自己的意思行事，不问尊长
entries.en: to act on one's own will, without the superior's leave
entries.notes: H 首字有[疑]（涇/徑），M quēng-chû 与「径自」相应。

entries.zh: 故意；存心违逆上意而行
entries.en: deliberately, on purpose; to act wilfully against authority

entries.zh: 俱能；样样会做，能做、会做
entries.en: to be able to do (everything); to know how to make

entries.zh: 快做成；赶快做好、迅速完成
entries.en: to do quickly and finish; to get something done fast

entries.zh: 戕贼；伤害、毁坏（行恶）
entries.en: to do harm, to injure, to ruin; to do evil
entries.notes: M 第二音节声调标记污损(T99)，仅影响声调，H「戕贼」义明确。

entries.zh: 殃害；加害于人、使人遭殃
entries.en: to bring harm or disaster upon someone

entries.zh: 照前；照原样、依前例来做
entries.en: to do according to the model; to follow the former pattern

entries.zh: 迁就；委曲顺从他人意愿（事非得已）
entries.en: to accommodate another's will; to yield, to indulge as far as one can
entries.notes: H 首字有[疑]（迁/遷），M chién-chiū 与「迁就」相应。

entries.zh: 作吊；为亡者办丧致祭
entries.en: to hold funeral rites for the dead; to pay mourning honours
entries.notes: H 首字有[疑]（作/仃），M chô 支持「作」。

entries.zh: 再任；再次为之、任其自便〔西语残损，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to do again; to allow once more (Spanish phrase corrupt, sense doubtful)
entries.notes: L「otrauz…sin juez」拼写残损，语义无法定夺；M chây-xīn 或当「再任」。

entries.zh: 作艺（做艺）；靠手艺营生、自食其力
entries.en: to work at one's craft or trade; to earn a living by one's own labour
entries.notes: M chôy 为 chô 之异写；L adquirir por sí 指自谋所得。

entries.zh: 听从；顺从上意（Sto 或指圣者、尊长）
entries.en: to obey; to do the will of another (Sto, prob. santo or a superior)
entries.notes: L 缩写 Sto 展开属推断，H「听从」义明。

entries.zh: 听命；遵命而行、听候差遣
entries.en: to obey orders; to do another's bidding
entries.notes: 同上条，Sto 为缩写，展开存推断。

entries.zh: 听做；听人吩咐而做〔西语作如情人般相爱，与汉栏不合，存疑〕
entries.en: to do as one is told (the Spanish reads like a lover, loving, which does not match)
entries.notes: L 与 H、M 不相合，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 刁难（挑难）；借故为难他人以图私利
entries.en: to obstruct and make things difficult for gain; to act purely for profit
entries.notes: M 首音节 T99 污损；H「挑」当为「刁」，M tiau-lān 可证。

entries.zh: 起厝；盖房子、建造房屋
entries.en: to build a house
entries.notes: M 首音节 T99 污损，仅影响声调；H、M 义吻合。

entries.zh: 非法；不依法度、胡乱行事
entries.en: to act unlawfully or improperly; to do in disorder
entries.notes: 西语 desordenadamente 侧重无序，H「非法」侧重违法，义近而非全等。

entries.zh: 非为；胡作非为、乱来
entries.en: to do wrong; to misbehave, to act improperly

entries.zh: 非正路；不走正道、行事乖方
entries.en: to take improper ways; to act irregularly, off the right path
entries.notes: M 第三音节 T99 污损，仅影响声调；H 义明确。
